captions: Most buyers decide | whether to make an [OFFER] | based on the *price* | and the [PHOTOS.] The ones who get into *trouble later* | are usually the ones | who didn't ask | a handful of *basic questions* [FIRST.] In this video, | I'm going to give you | [FOUR QUESTIONS] | to ask *before you offer* | on any property, | *residential* or [COMMERCIAL.] I'm Jake, | the founder of | [CALIBRE ACQUIRE.] I've worked in property | for [14 YEARS] | and transacted on over | [£80 MILLION] | worth of *commercial property investments* | in the past year *alone.* I help investors | get out of *underperforming* property assets | and into ones | that actually work [HARDER] | for them. Question one | is the [TENANT'S STRENGTH.] Who's paying the rent, | and how *secure* is it? If the property is tenanted, | you're not just buying | a [BUILDING,] | you're buying the tenant's | *ability* | to keep [PAYING.] Ask how long | they've been in [OCCUPATION,] | whether they've ever | missed a [PAYMENT,] | and how long is left | on the [LEASE.] The asking price | can often look the *same* | and reflect the same [YIELD,] | but it can cause issues | *further down the line.* If you're considering a property | and want to [STRESS TEST] it | within a few minutes, | I've built calculators | for [MIXED-USE,] | [HMO] | and *single residential* deals, so you can put in | the *real numbers* | and see what a deal | [ACTUALLY RETURNS,] | not just what it looks like | on the *surface.* Completely [FREE.] Comment the word [SEND] below, | or use the link below | to get access. Question two, | the [TRUE COST.] What does this *actually cost* | beyond the [PURCHASE PRICE?] Service charge, | ground rent, | repairs, | planning constraints. | These don't show up | in the *headline figure,* but they affect your return | [EVERY YEAR] | that you hold onto | the property. Ask for the last | [THREE YEARS'] | *service charge accounts* | if there's one in place. Ask whether any [MAJOR WORKS] | are planned | or *already agreed.* A property that looks *cheaper on paper* | can end up costing | a lot [MORE] | once these are *factored in.* Question three, | the vendor's [MOTIVATION.] Why is the vendor | *actually* [SELLING?] This shapes how the [NEGOTIATION] goes | and what you might *uncover.* A vendor selling | because of [PROBATE,] | [RETIREMENT] | or a *change in circumstances* | behaves [DIFFERENTLY] | to one selling | because the property | has become a [PROBLEM.] It's not always something | you'll get a *straight answer* to, | but it's worth asking | your [AGENT] | or [SOLICITOR] | what they know. The reason behind a sale | often explains things | the listing itself [WON'T.] Question four | is the [EXIT STRATEGY.] Who would *buy this* | from me [LATER?] Before you buy it, | it's worth knowing | what your *future buyer* | looks like. A property with [BROAD APPEAL,] | *good location,* | *flexible use,* | no unusual *lease structure,* | is [EASIER] to sell on. A highly *specific* asset | could be [HARDER] to move, | even at a *fair price.* This doesn't mean | you need to plan an exit | on [DAY ONE.] But if you can't picture | who'd want to buy the property | in [FIVE OR 10 YEARS,] | that's worth considering | *before you make an offer.* None of these questions | *guarantee* a good outcome | on their [OWN.] But asking them | [BEFORE] you offer, | rather than *after* you've exchanged, | puts you in a much | [STRONGER POSITION.] If you'd like access to properties | before they reach the *open market,* | you can apply | using the link below. I go through | every application | [PERSONALLY,] | and if it's a good fit | and we've got *positions available,* | I'll be in [TOUCH.] I'll see you | in the next video.

title_card.text: Before you offer, ask: / [WHO’S PAYING] / [THE RENT?]
